sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder is the latest series of Code-Specific Qwen large language models (formerly known as CodeQwen). As of now, Qwen2.5-Coder has covered six mainstream model sizes, 0.5, 1.5, 3, 7, 14, 32 billion parameters, to meet the needs of different developers.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder inherits the vocabulary from Qwen2.5 but introduces several special tokens to help the model better understand code. Table 2 presents an overview of the special tokens added during training to better capture different forms of code data.
